# Fortune Jobs AI

> Fortune Jobs AI (fortunejobsai.com) is a free AI-powered job portal for college students, new graduates and job seekers. It lists 20,000+ open jobs refreshed daily, gives a free ATS résumé score, ranks jobs against your résumé, filters for jobs that mention visa sponsorship or OPT, and tracks your applications.

Jobs come from employer career boards (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, SmartRecruiters, Workable, Breezy), USAJOBS and job-search partners (Adzuna, WhatJobs). Every listing links to the original posting. Most jobs are tech and data roles; healthcare jobs such as registered nurse are growing. Jobs cover all 50 states and Washington, DC.

Creating an account and the core tools are free; the free plan shows 10 results per search. Fortune Jobs AI Pro costs $9.99 a month for 50+ results per search and more AI actions. Fortune Jobs AI is operated by YOU DO LMS INC., a New Jersey corporation.

## Main pages
- [Home and job search](https://fortunejobsai.com/): search by role, city or state, or describe the job in plain English
- [Find jobs](https://fortunejobsai.com/find-jobs.html): search jobs by title and location
- [Jobs by state and city](https://fortunejobsai.com/jobs/): live job counts for each role, state and major city
- [Free ATS résumé score and matching](https://fortunejobsai.com/resume-search.html): upload a résumé for an ATS score and matching jobs
- [Résumé builder](https://fortunejobsai.com/resume-builder.html): build an ATS-friendly résumé and download a PDF
- [About](https://fortunejobsai.com/about.html)
- [Contact](https://fortunejobsai.com/contact.html): info@fortunejobsai.com

## Frequently asked questions
- **Is Fortune Jobs AI free?** Yes. Job search, the ATS résumé score, AI job matching and the application tracker are free. Pro is $9.99 a month for more results and AI actions.
- **Where do the jobs come from?** Employer career boards, USAJOBS and job-search partners such as Adzuna and WhatJobs. Each listing links to the original posting.
- **Can I find jobs that mention visa sponsorship or OPT?** Yes, with the work-authorization filter. Always confirm sponsorship with the employer.
- **Who is it for?** College students, new graduates, international students and anyone searching for a job.
- **How often are jobs updated?** Daily; closed listings are removed when the source no longer shows them.
